comment: Divergence ledger — read by the unified corpus gate (corpus_gate); BOTH
channels gate commits. Replaces the report-only known_diffs.json. Entries
mask NOTHING silently: each pins WHERE and HOW MUCH a case may diverge on a
channel and FAILS the gate when stale (a divergence that no longer exceeds
the tier floor, or an entry whose scope never matched). Envelopes are per-
case, per-channel, per-scope MEASURED facts with a mandatory cause+source —
NEVER a tolerance (tier floors in tests/harness are untouched and structurally
unreachable from here). Every add/widen/flip lands as a population-lock diff.
Kinds: 'divergence' (field-granular envelope, re-asserted within its pin),
'skip' (hard-crash decks, the other channel still gates), 'exclusion' (proven
upstream bug poisons scoped comparisons, everything else compared).

causes.fpc-delphi-ulp: Delphi(EPRI r4133)-vs-FPC(dss_capi 0.14.5/port) last-ulp libm differences amplified through the solve; the port matches the pinned FPC 0.14.5 oracle EXACTLY (the capi_v0145 channel is bit-clean) while r4133's Delphi build settles a near-identical state a few ulp away. Same class as the proven dSpeed cancellation floor (CLAUDE.md); a floor of the cross-engine build, not a port bug.
causes.iteration-count-delta: Solve/control fixpoint iteration-count deltas vs r4133: Delphi-vs-FPC last-ulp rounding shifts convergence-check outcomes and the reworked controls iterate differently (AutoTrans+RegControl reg-tap, GenDispatcher dispatch). The port matches the pinned FPC oracle's EXACT count on capi_v0145; on r4133 the state is near-identical in a different iteration count. CORRECTION (2026-09-03, RP3.12): the AutoTrans+RegControl share of this is NOT an iteration/last-ulp effect. r4133 never taps an AutoTrans at all -- its RegControl reads the controlled element through an unchecked TTransfObj(ControlledElement) cast (Version8/Source/Controls/RegControl.pas:926, :1026, :1296, :1370, :1479) over TAutoTransObj = class(TPDElement) (Version8/Source/PDElements/AutoTrans.pas:88), and the punned increment zeroes PendingTapChange (:1249-1250) -- so it converges in 3 iterations because no control ever arms, and the state is NOT near-identical (2.2-2.6% at the regulated bus). See cause regcontrol-autotrans-typecast. The GenDispatcher share of this cause is unaffected.
causes.injection-fpc-delphi-ulp: Injection RHS entries a small factor above the calibrated faer-vs-KLU floor on IndMach-bearing asymmetric decks: Delphi-vs-FPC transcendental last-ulp amplified by the machine model (same class as the dSpeed cancellation floor). Injection assembly + machine model byte-identical across the EPRI delta.
causes.storage-display-precision: EPRI r4133's Delphi renders StorageController-dispatched Storage properties (.kw / %stored / kwhstored) to ~6 significant figures where the port/pinned-oracle return full f64 — a Delphi-vs-FPC Format/Str last-digit RENDERING difference, not an op-point move (expected == actual rounded to 6 sf). The port matches the pinned FPC oracle. Ledgered as exact-pair property/probe entries (discrete state, never an envelope).
causes.pvsystem-display-precision: EPRI r4133's Delphi renders the PVSystem kvar/kva property to ~6 significant figures where the port/pinned-oracle return full f64 — the same Delphi-vs-FPC Format/Str rendering difference as storage-display-precision, exact-pair only.
causes.property-format-brackets: dss_capi's rewritten property system renders array-valued PropertyValue with brackets ('[ 1900 1500 2300]') where EPRI returns plain space-separated ('1900 1500 2300') — a property-rendering difference (dss_capi docs/known_differences.md). Exact-pair only.
causes.eventlog-trailing-space: EPRI r4133 writes a trailing space after relay/control event-log action text ('...LOCKED OUT '); the port (matching dss_capi) trims it. A whitespace rendering artifact on the diffing line only.
causes.harmonics-ieee519-r4133: The documented r4088->r4133 harmonics-mode voltage move on the IEEE_519 filter deck (WP-U0.2; docs/upgrade/sweeps): node V ~4.3e-4 at pcc with the assembled Y bit-identical. Source-confirmed byte-identical harmonics path r4088=r4133 => a build-to-build Delphi last-ulp drift amplified by the near-resonance of the 519 filter (ill-conditioned harmonics fixpoint), NOT a portable behavior change. The port matches the pinned FPC oracle and its own physically-correct harmonics solution.
causes.regcontrol-autotrans-typecast: EPRI r4133's RegControl reaches its controlled element through an unchecked TTransfObj(ControlledElement) typecast (Version8/Source/Controls/RegControl.pas:926, :1026, :1296, :1370, :1479) while TAutoTransObj = class(TPDElement) (Version8/Source/PDElements/AutoTrans.pas:88) is not a TTransfObj and TAutoWinding (AutoTrans.pas:59) stops matching TWinding (Transformer.pas:62) after Rdcohms. TapIncrement therefore reads the winding's MaxTap (1.1 pu) and PendingTapChange := Round(BoostNeeded/Increment)*Increment (RegControl.pas:1249-1250) rounds every realistic boost to zero, so r4133 NEVER taps an AutoTrans: 0 event-log lines on all four controls:autotrans decks, the regulated bus left BELOW its band on every one of them (autotrans_reg: LOW.1/166 = 118.04 V against vreg=120 band=2, i.e. 0.96 V under the 119 V edge and 1.96 V under the setpoint; midi_autotrans: AT69.1/332 = 119.25 V against vreg=123 band=1.5, 3.00 V under the 122.25 V edge and 3.75 V under the setpoint) with 5-11 taps of headroom unused, and its winding currents and node voltages are the UNREGULATED circuit's (3-7.5% on AutoTrans.WdgCurrents winding 2, 2.2-2.6% at the regulated bus). Measured on the live r4133 DLL: E1 -- 'Edit AutoTrans.at wdg=2 maxtap=X' then '? RegControl.rat.tapnum' returns Round(puTap/maxtap) exactly (X=2.2 -> 0, X=1.1 -> 1, X=0.55 -> 2; the correct answers are -14, 0, -25); E2 -- 'tapnum=0' leaves taps=[1, 1.58101E-322], the winding's NumTaps=32 reinterpreted as a Double; E5 -- forcing vreg=40 finally arms it and the event log reads 'CHANGED -1 TAPS TO 1.58101E-322'; E6 -- the same four decks with the RegControl disabled make the port print r4133's census literals byte for byte. Present identically in r3723, r4088 and r4133; dss_capi 0.14.5 does not have it (both classes share a TControlledTransformerObj base). Per CLAUDE.md (2026-08-02) the bug is NOT reproduced in any lane: the port keeps the regulated answer, pinned by props_r4133_pins::autotrans_wdgcurrents_stay_regulated_where_r4133_never_taps_the_autotrans. Upstream report investigations/to_opendss/50-regcontrol-autotrans-ttransfobj-typecast.md. SUPERSEDES the 2026-07-18 cause key 'autotrans-regcontrol-tap' ('the reg-tap resolves on a different discrete step ... so it is FPC-vs-Delphi, not a port bug'), which was the conditioning excuse CLAUDE.md forbids and is disproven: r4133 does not resolve the tap one step later, it never resolves one at all. No entry references this key today -- the four decks are engines=capi_v0145, so no r4133 comparison runs on them; the case-level r4133 'skip' entries are drafted for the day they gain the channel (RP3.12, tmp/rp312/staged_ledger.md).
causes.makeposseq-fpc-delphi: MakePosSequence reduced parameters are quantized to FIVE significant digits on EPRI r4133 and kept at full precision by the pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 and the port: every r4133 MakePosSequence override builds a command STRING with Format('%-.5g') and re-parses it (Version8/Source/PDElements/Capacitor.pas:801, :806 and :829 into the Parser at :834-835; the same shape in PCElements/Vsource.pas:1396-1402, PCElements/Load.pas:2305-2332, PDElements/Line.pas:1591-1596), while capi 0.14.5 aims typed setters at the same properties. Measured 2026-09-04 on modes:makeposseq/makeposseq_shunt.dss (GOLDEN_REBASE G1.4a F8, census + decomposition): the reduced kV reads 7.1996 on r4133 against the port's 7.19955785679463 (rel 5.85e-06), load.kw 133.33 vs 133.333333333333 (2.50e-05), reactor.r 0.26667 vs 0.266666666666667 (1.25e-05); the quantized Vsource base kV alone moves the injection RHS by 3.407076218201843e-02 (rel 5.854e-06) with the cmatrix capacitor removed, while WITHOUT the trailing makeposseq the two oracles agree to f64-ulp (max 9.094947e-13, rel 1.563e-16). It is a value difference, not the transcendental last-ulp drift this cause used to claim (that text was a misdiagnosis, rewritten under coordinator decision D14). No entry references it: the makeposseq decks gate on capi 0.14.5, where the quantization does not exist, and modes:makeposseq/makeposseq_gic.dss gates on r4133 with every reduced parameter chosen so the 5-digit round trip is exact (basekv = 7.2*sqrt(3), kw=900, pf=1).

causes.gic-pct-r2-ignored: GICTransformer `%R`-specified winding 2: both oracle revisions compute G2 := 100.0 / (FZBase2 * FPctR1) -- the G1 line above copied with the base renamed and the percentage not (pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 src/PDElements/GICTransformer.pas:441; EPRI r4133 Version8/Source/PDElements/GICTransformer.pas:495 is the same line) -- so a user's %R2 is stored and read back but never reaches the admittance. It is a slip, not a convention: the same procedure's else arm restores FPctR2 from G2 (:446 / r4133 :498), and the forward and reverse maps are inverses of each other only when the forward one reads FPctR2. Per the 2026-08-02 policy (CLAUDE.md: upstream bugs are never reproduced) GOLDEN_REBASE_PLAN.md G2.5 fixed it in both lanes. These two decks are type=Auto, where the BusX side effect (:251) puts the G1 and G2 blocks in series on the H->X->neutral path, so the element admittance, the assembled Y, every node voltage and every element current move against BOTH oracles (measured 2026-08-06: node V 4.502e-4 V on gictransformer_gic against an allowed 1.001e-6, 1.021e-4 against 1.074e-6 on gic_midi; the tg3/tg5 YPrim block by 4/3). Correct value pinned by dss_core::exec::tests::compat_quirks::gic_transformer_pct_r2_drives_winding_two (crates/dss-core/src/exec/tests/compat_quirks.rs), which measures the %R path against the R1=/R2= ohms path -- the same procedure's else arm, which neither revision ever got wrong and which these very decks also exercise (tg2/tg3, R1=0.2 R2=0.1). Report side: tests/golden/reports/export_gicmvars value columns masked and pinned by golden_reports::export_gicmvars_matches_the_equivalent_ohms_spec; props side: the gictransformer_auto scenario's R2 excluded in props_roundtrip::LANE_SKIP_SCENARIO_PROPS. Blast-radius note (2026-08-07 settle): the divergence class is ANY %R-specified GICTransformer, not just decks that set both percentages -- a deck writing only %R1= now gives winding 2 the %R2 creation default 0.2 (GICTransformer.pas:409-410, r4133 :458-459) instead of repeating %R1. No corpus deck has that shape (the two decks above are the only %R decks and both set both), so only they are ledgered. Channel note (GOLDEN_REBASE G1.4a, 2026-09-04, coordinator decision D12): both decks now gate on r4133 ONLY -- capi 0.14.5 is nondeterministic across processes on any deck that instantiates a GICTransformer -- so the two capi-side entries were deleted and only the r4133 twins remain. The divergence itself is unchanged and still present in both revisions; the pins named above are port-side and read no capi oracle.
causes.makeposseq-cuf-discarded: Capacitor MakePosSequence CMatrix arm: the positive-sequence capacitance Cs - Cm is computed and then lost. dss_capi 0.14.5 aims the SCALAR setter at the ARRAY property Cuf -- SetDouble(ord(TProp.Cuf), (Cs - Cm), []) at src/PDElements/Capacitor.pas:814, whose SetObjDouble tail (src/General/DSSObjectHelper.pas:2812-2834) enumerates only the three scalar double types and has no else -- so the value is dropped with no error while the success path (:3050-3054) still marks the property sequence and runs the Cuf side effect SpecType := 2 (:383-386); the bank then computes from whatever FC held (here the kvar=1200 kv=12.47 creation default, 20.4699706679377 uF) and the user's cmatrix is switched out of MakeYprimWork for good (:926-978). EPRI r4133 predates the typed setters and formats the same value into a command string (Version8/Source/PDElements/Capacitor.pas:829, :834-835), so it DOES apply it through InterpretDblArray (Version8/Source/Common/Utilities.pas:788-791, 'Fills array with zeros if we run out of numbers') -- but Cmatrix is already in farads there (:255) while the cuf side effect multiplies the parsed array by 1.0e-6 again (:411), landing 4e-12 F where 4e-6 F was meant. Neither revision produces the intended bank, and what was intended is unambiguous because r4133 spells the array write out, so GOLDEN_REBASE_PLAN.md G2.5 performs it in both lanes in the property's own uF units. Capacitor.cap_cmat then becomes 4 uF where the oracle keeps 20.47 uF, which moves that element's YPrim, the assembled Y, the node voltages (measured 2026-08-06: 1.158e-1 V against an allowed 3.339e-6) and every element current. Correct value pinned by dss_core::elements::pd::capacitor::tests::make_pos_sequence_cmatrix_applies_the_positive_sequence_cuf (crates/dss-core/src/elements/pd/capacitor/tests.rs), which asserts the reduced bank is indistinguishable from one declared phases=1 cuf=4, and by ...::make_pos_sequence_cmatrix for the emitted action.
causes.mmf-text-accept-set: LoadShape memory-mapped plain-text reader: both oracle revisions filter each comma-delimited column through an accept-set of bytes in [46,58) -- '.' (46), '/' (47) and the digits (48-57) -- pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 src/General/LoadShape.pas:1374 and EPRI r4133 Version8/Source/Common/Utilities.pas:834, the same line. That deletes the sign (45), '+' (43), the exponent letter e/E (101/69) and whitespace while keeping '/' inside the token, so -0.5 reads as 0.5 and 1.5e-3 as 1.53. It is a slip in the mapped reader, not a second file format: TLoadShapeObj owns a SECOND reader for the same file -- ReadCSVFile's non-mapped branch (:1044), which hands each row to the aux parser -- and MemoryMapping=Yes selects how a shape is stored, not what its bytes mean, so the two must agree on identical input. GOLDEN_REBASE_PLAN.md G2.5 made both take the column verbatim through that same parser, in both lanes. shape_mmf.dss exists TO OBSERVE the quirk (its mmpq8.csv P column is written in exponent notation on purpose), so ls_pq now reads {0.15, 0.20, ...} instead of {1.51, 2.01, ...} and the deck moves wholesale against the pinned oracle (measured 2026-08-06: node V 1.641e1 V against an allowed 8.179e-6; Load.ld_pq's YPrim, the assembled Y, the injection RHS, every element channel and all four monitors follow). Correct values pinned by dss_core::elements::general::load_shape::tests::mmf_text_reader_agrees_with_its_non_mapped_twin and ...::mmf_plaintext_reader_keeps_sign_and_exponent (crates/dss-core/src/elements/general/load_shape/tests.rs). The deck's UNRELATED coverage -- the sngfile=/dblfile= MMF readers, the raw mult=(sngfile=) directive form, the pqcsvfile= two-column reader, the array-property round-trip and the Set/Get totaltime surface -- moved to the sibling deck modes:inputformat/shape_mmf_io/shape_mmf_io.dss, which gates clean on the same channel; that exactly one deck can see the change is measured in bytes by ...::mmf_accept_set_fix_is_gated_by_exactly_one_deck.
causes.epri-303-crash: EPRI r4133 raises a #303/#58614 access violation on this deck (binary/MMF GrowthShape, line/cable spacing, or the dss-ext CapControl Type=Follow ControlSignal feature) where the port and the pinned 0.14.5 oracle solve it correctly; the r4133 channel cannot compare it. dss-extensions-era known regression; no port action. causes.ncim-oppoint: NCIM (Newton-Current-Injection) is a 0.15.x/r4133 solver the pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 lacks entirely (Set algorithm=NCIM ignored, Export deltaf #24713), so only the r4133 channel gates an NCIM deck — r4133 is the oracle-of-record for NCIM (the capi015 0.15.0b4 probe venv is retired). RESOLVED by the oracle-of-record flip capi015→r4133 (own r4133 epri-worker probes, r4133 = 'Version 11.0.0.1 (64-bit build)', 2026-07-20): the 4 NCIM decks (modes ncim_pq/ncim_pv_pq/ncim_midi + solvable_now Xmission_System_Kundur2Area) are LIVE-gated on r4133 with NO ledger entry — the whole-model compare (node V, system Y, the Vsource swing current/power/loss, the NCIM generators, and the warm-resolve iteration count) is within the tier floor on every case. Converged node V is DIGIT-IDENTICAL r4133-vs-port (~1e-12 faer-vs-KLU); the swing-source reported current now MATCHES r4133 to the floor after dropping the capi015 0.15.0b4 (e936d210) one-conductor off-by-one in VSource — r4133 VSource.pas l.1123/1158 fills GetCurrents(@(ElmCurrents[1])) (offset write → unshifted read); the port aligned in exec/view.rs::ncim_swing_source_currents (the TODO(compat) was removed). RP3.13 (2026-09-03) retired that gate-only override: the sum is now ported as solution::solution::ncim::ncim_stamp_swing_source_currents, stamped into the source's Iterminal at the end of do_ncim_solution and returned by the NCIM arm of elements/pc/vsource/solve.rs, so one live state feeds the gate reader and the element path alike (no snapshot_elements NCIM special case is left). Its PC term SUBTRACTS, where r4133 adds (VSource.pas l.1169 vs l.1135): that cadd is an upstream KCL sign bug, measured 2026-09-03 on a deck with a load bonded onto the swing bus and not reproduced in either lane (pin ncim_swing_sum_subtracts_pc_terminals_and_closes_kcl); it is unreachable on every gated NCIM case, which carries no PC element on the swing bus (pin ncim_swing_bus_carries_no_pc_element_on_the_gated_decks). Warm-resolve iterations match r4133 exactly (2/2/2 on the modes decks, 1 on Kundur2Area). This cause is now documentary (referenced by no entry); see docs/upgrade/DIVERGENCES.md and exec/tests/ncim.rs.
causes.gfm-pctstored-rounding: Grid-forming (GFM) storage decks: the r4133 physics matches the port (the port adopted the r4133 Isc1 default, DIVERGENCES.md #b5) EXCEPT the Storage.%stored property getter STRING, which r4133's Delphi rounds to ~4-6 decimals (e.g. 92.4321) where the port/pinned-oracle return full f64 (92.4320641163609) — a getter rendering difference, exact-pair only. On the capi_v0145 channel the deck cannot gate: 0.14.5's different Isc1 default makes the assembled system-Y differ wholesale (x1000), a deliberate model default the port follows r4133 on.
causes.regcontrol-idle: RegControl `idle` is a 0.15.x/r4133 feature the pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 rejects (#110 Unknown parameter 'idle'), so only the r4133 channel gates the idle-regulator deck. BUG WP regcontrol_idle (2026-07-19): the port adopted r4133's no-load-zone AND semantics (idle when the through-power is inside the BOUNDED [RevPowerThreshold, FwdPowerThreshold] band; r4133 RegControl.pas:1218). dss_capi 0.15.x wrote it as an `or` (8a898cba, still OR at the 0.15.x tip) — a tautology under the default symmetric band that made an idling reg never tap; the port previously reproduced it (MV.1 8.8% low). After adoption the idle tap/voltage match r4133 exactly (tapnum 15, tap 1.09375, MV.1=7650.08 V; probe D: widening fwdThreshold to bracket the load makes r4133 idle to the old 7030.24 V, proving the bounded-AND mechanism). The only residual is a getter-convention difference on revThreshold/fwdThreshold: r4133's getter returns the InitPropertyValues display strings (revThreshold '100' = band half-width, RegControl.pas:1448; fwdThreshold unset '') decoupled from the signed internal, while the port reports the signed effective thresholds in kW (rev -100, fwd +100). Definitional, not physics — exact-pair.
causes.linespacing-normamps: Line built from LineSpacing+wiredata: dss_capi 0.14.5 reports Line.lsp.normamps=730/emergamps=1095 (the FIRST wire's NormAmps rating, ACSR_556) where the port and the newer engines (0.15.x/r4133) report 230/345 — the MINIMUM NormAmps over the phase conductors (min{556->730, 4-0->340, 1-0->230}=230; r4133 V8 LineGeometry.pas:1237-1239, WP-U1.2 D3). The port follows the corrected 0.15.x min-over-phase derivation, so on capi_v0145 it intentionally diverges from 0.14.5 (settled empirically 2026-07-18: port=230/345, oracle 0.14.5=730/1095 — the port value matches the r4133 source and is CORRECT). r4133 additionally #303-crashes this deck (skip). Exact-pair property entry on capi_v0145.
causes.generator-makeposseq-foreign-slots: dss_capi 0.14.5's TGeneratorObj.MakePosSequence decides "the user set kVA=/MVA=" from the raw property-sequence slots [26]/[27] (Generator.pas:2804-2806), but its enum reorder moved Xdp/Xdpp into 26/27 while kVA/MVA sit at 23/24, so both rating guards read foreign cells: a 3-phase generator declared with kVA=/MVA= keeps its full rating after makeposseq instead of having it divided by the phase count. EPRI r4133 writes the same two literals (Version8/Source/PCElements/generator.pas:3060-3062) but there they are CORRECT — kVA is registered at 26 and MVA at 27 (:459-460), Xdp/Xdpp at 29/30 (:463/:465) — so the defect is a dss_capi regression, not upstream behaviour. Per the 2026-08-02 policy the port follows r4133 in both lanes and divides the rating; the pinned 0.14.5 oracle keeps the undivided value. Exact-pair (a discrete value jump, not display precision).
causes.line-merge-length-units-reset: TLineObj.MergeWith's matrix-model series branch and the length units. EPRI r4133 saves the units before the merge (Version8/Source/PDElements/Line.pas:1627 LenUnitsSaved := LengthUnits) and re-applies them with a SEPARATE Edit that runs AFTER the Rmatrix/Xmatrix (:1778-1779) and Cmatrix (:1791-1792) Edits -- Format(' Length=%-g  Units=%s', [TotalLen, LineUnitsStr(LenUnitsSaved)]) at :1794-1796 -- precisely because the 12..14 property side effect calls ResetLengthUnits (:691-693). Its MakePosSequence uses the same construction for the same reason (:1595-1596, 'Repeat the Length Units to compensate for unexpected reset'). The pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 inverted the two: src/PDElements/Line.pas:1806-1807 writes Len and LengthUnits as FIELDS and :1815-1817 then runs PropertySideEffects(rmatrix/xmatrix/cmatrix), whose ResetLengthUnits (:2080-2085) wipes LengthUnits back to UNITS_NONE one statement later, so every matrix-model series merge on 0.14.5 reports 'none'. The port had copied that order; r4133 is the behavioral authority and its bugs are never reproduced (CLAUDE.md 2026-08-02), so R4133_PROPS_PLAN RP3.5 fixed it in BOTH lanes and the three merged lines of this deck now render their saved 'kft'. Probed live 2026-08-28 on the r4133 DLL (Version 11.0.0.1, tools/opendss/bin/r4133): 'kft' on all three merged lines here, and deck-dependent elsewhere ('mi'/'cm' on two purpose-built micro-decks, 'none' on a switch), so the getter is live state (LineUnitsStr(LengthUnits), :1404) and not an echo. NOTHING ELSE MOVES: ConvertLineUnits returns 1.0 whenever either side is UNITS_NONE (Shared/LineUnits.pas:110-115), so FUnitsConvert is 1.0 on both engines either way and the merged line's YPrim, the assembled Y, the node voltages, currents, powers, losses, the node count (88) and the iteration count (5) are identical -- 'units' is the only divergent cell on the whole case, measured on all three engines. Correct value pinned by dss_core::exec::tests::reduce::merged_matrix_line_keeps_the_surviving_lines_length_units, which reads two micro-decks whose surviving lines carry DIFFERENT saved units (so the pin cannot pass against a hardwired getter) plus an un-merged control and a post-merge rmatrix= reset.
causes.line-switch-kills-linecode: TLineObj.PropertySideEffects arm 15 (switch=) and the LineCode flag. EPRI r4133 keeps TWO independent pieces of state: FLineCodeSpecified (Boolean) and CondCode (the lowercased code name), both set by FetchLineCode (Version8/Source/PDElements/Line.pas:385-387, :413). causes.windgen-qmode0-no-arm: WindGen steady-state QMode dispatch: TWindGenObj.SetNominalGeneration's `case WindModelDyn.QMode` (EPRI r4133 Version8/Source/PCElements/WindGen.pas:1276-1322) implements arm 1 (PF, :1277-1288) and arm 2 (volt-var, :1289-1319) and has NO arm 0, so `Else kvarCalc := 0` (:1320-1321) zeroes the reactive dispatch - while QMode DEFAULTS to 0 (Create, :1020), the property help documents it as 'Q control mode (0:Q, 1:PF, 2:VV)' (:429-430), and the dynamics model spells the same mode `QMode := 0; // 0 -> Constant Q` (WTG3_Model.pas:252) and implements it as `Qord := Qref` (:1059-1061). A default-configured WindGen therefore injects ZERO vars in power flow however its kvar=/pf= reads. It is an omission, not a design: the same engine dispatches the base kvar whenever the case is bypassed (model=4 / DoFixedQGen, :1797, comment :1775 'Q is always kvarBase' - probed terminal Q -726.4287342535065 kvar on windgen_snap_delta and -985.9891404764404 on windgen_daily, i.e. it injects the base), arm 1's own saturation fallback IS kvarBase (:1284), arm 2 is kvarBase scaled by the VV curve and saturated at |kvarBase| (:1313-1316 - probed: a flat y=+1 curve dispatches exactly kvarBase), and the parent class writes the dispatch outright (Generator.pas:1163), which WindGen could not transcribe because its ShapeFactor carries the wind SPEED rather than a pu multiplier (:1241). Probed live on the r4133 DLL (Version 11.0.0.1, R4133_PROPS_PLAN RP3.10 investigation): QMode=0 dispatches exactly 0 on all five decks and in every configuration, including decks that type kvar=, pf= and kVA=; `edit QMode=0` is inert; and no other site fills Qnominalperphase for mode 0 (complete 20-hit write census: :1245 turbine-off, :1325 the dispatch, and the two overwritten seeds :3002/:3025; InitDQDVCalc/BumpUpQ/ResetStartPoint have no WindGen caller, Common/Solution.pas:963-1000 walking Generators only). Per the 2026-08-02 policy (CLAUDE.md: upstream bugs are never reproduced in any lane) R4133_PROPS_PLAN RP3.10 implements `0: kvarCalc := kvarBase` in BOTH lanes (crates/dss-core/src/elements/pc/windgen/nominal.rs), as kvarCalc = kvarBase read RAW where kVA= is unset (SyncUpPowerQuantities :3028 / Set_Presentkvar :3001 have already put the pf convention's sign into it there) and as |kvarBase| with LeadLag = -1 for PFNominal < 0 in the branch where a typed kVA= has stripped that sign - arm 1's own discipline (:1286-1287). No kVArating clamp, because arm 1's saturation test cannot fire: kVATmp = sqrt(Pg^2 + kvarCalc^2) is Pg/|PF| and Pg is capped at kWBase (:1268-1269), so kVATmp <= kWBase/|PF| == kVArating bit-for-bit (measured on 3000/0.95, 1584/0.88, 1080/0.9). The sign must come from PFNominal and not from kvarBase alone: RecalcElementData's kVA-set branch re-derives kvarBase := sqrt(kVArating^2 - kWBase^2) (:1377-1378), a non-negative root that strips the sign a typed pf<0 (:3028) or kvar<0 (:3001) put there, so reading the base raw would dispatch the OPPOSITE sign from arm 1 on identical tokens - probed live on r4133 for kW=1000 kVA=1200 pf=-0.9, arm 1 gives terminal Q +523.0678462465884 kvar (the machine ABSORBS, which is what pf<0 means) while upstream's own model=4, reading the stripped base through varBase, gives terminal Q -523.0475290915948 (injecting); this engine's mode 0 follows arm 1. With kVA= unset the two formulations are bit-identical. Factor (GenMultiplier) still applies because :1325 sits outside the case (probed: Set genmult=0.5 halves it). The dispatch feeds Yeq (:1338), so it moves every GenModel that reads Yeq - model 1 (the only one any modes:windgen deck declares), model 2 and the model-6 YPrim seed; models 4/5 read varBase and are untouched. The four decks that declare a WindGen without a QMode= token therefore diverge from r4133 across the solved model; the fifth, modes:windgen/windgen_snap.dss, types pf=1.0 so its kvarBase is 0 and the new arm is a literal no-op there (measured: that case stays fully compared and green, and gets no entry). Correct values pinned by dss_core::elements::pc::windgen::tests::qmode0_dispatches_the_base_kvar, ::qmode0_dispatch_carries_the_sign_and_scales_with_genmult and ::qmode0_zero_only_when_the_base_is_zero (crates/dss-core/src/elements/pc/windgen/tests.rs), which name both engines' numbers; the dynamics state by ::dynamics_variables_match_the_qmode0_dispatch. Upstream report: investigations/to_opendss/55-windgen-qmode0-zero-var-dispatch.md (local). The property side is untouched: r4133's kvar getter renders the DISPATCHED Q (:2896 -> :2297-2300, RP3.2's finding) and the port renders kvar_base (elements/pc/windgen/accessors.rs), which this dispatch never writes, so the four r4133-windgen-kvar-dispatched-* property entries keep their pinned pairs unchanged.
causes.capcontrol-time-bus-is-the-capacitors: CapControl TIMECONTROL terminal-1 bus association: EPRI r4133 requires a monitored element for every control type except FOLLOWCONTROL (Version8/Source/Controls/CapControl.pas:605, `ElmReq := ElmReq and (ControlType <> FOLLOWCONTROL)`) and binds the control's own bus 1 to that element's ElementTerminal (:622, `Setbus(1, MonitoredElement.GetBus(ElementTerminal))`); the `ControlledElement.GetBus(1)` fallback at :633 is the no-monitored-element arm only. The pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 still carries the pre-b9bc87b8 form: for TIMECONTROL *and* FOLLOWCONTROL it sets `effElement := ControlledElement` and forces `ElementTerminal := 1` (src/Controls/CapControl.pas:597-608), then `Setbus(1, effElement.GetBus(ElementTerminal))` (:619) -- i.e. the *capacitor's* bus. The port follows r4133 (crates/dss-core/src/elements/control/cap_control/mod.rs, the `control_type != Follow` arm), which is the same adoption DIVERGENCES.md D11 (part 2) already recorded for the effElement/Terminal readback; G1.3a's `VoltagesMagAng` channel is the first gate that makes the *bus* half observable, because the field reads NodeV through the element's own NodeRef. So on a `type=time element=...` CapControl the capi_v0145 channel reports the capacitor's bus voltage and the port (= r4133) the monitored element's terminal voltage -- a different bus, not a numeric gap. The r4133 channel of the same case compares clean and needs no entry. Both numbers pinned by dss_core::exec::tests::derived_polar::capcontrol_time_voltages_follow_the_monitored_elements_terminal.
causes.visualize-dssview-file-pair: `Visualize <quantity> <element>` writes a DSSView file PAIR on EPRI r4133 and NOTHING at all on the pinned dss_capi 0.14.5, so a deck that issues it diverges on the created-file SET of the r4133 channel only. r4133 Version8/Source/Executive/ExecHelper.pas:3672 (DoVisualizeCmd) dispatches to TDSSPlot.DoVisualizationPlot (Version8/Source/Plot/DSSPlot.pas:3642), which builds GetOutputDirectory + CircuitName_ + Format('%s_%s_PQ.DSV', [class, name]) (:3728 + :3746 for vizPOWER; :3730 _V.DSV and :3739 _I.DSV for the other two quantities) and calls MakeNewGraph (:3758). MakeNewGraph (Version8/Source/Plot/DSSGraph.pas:109) Rewrites that .DSV text file (:114-115) and then FileCreates its binary companion ChangeFileExt(ActiveFileName, '.dbl') (:125, :128) -- hence the PAIR, one file per DSSView viewer artifact. dss_capi 0.14.5 src/Executive/ExecHelper.pas:4099 instead assembles a TJSONObject {PlotType: 'Visualize', ElementName, ElementType, Quantity} (:4184-4189) and hands the formatted string to DSS.DSSPlotCallback, opening no file; with the headless oracle's NIL callback it is a pure no-op. The port follows the JSON payload (crates/dss-core/src/exec/command.rs:865-968 -> exec/plot.rs:405-421, fire_visualize_callback): a headless Rust engine has no DSSView to feed, and a callback payload is the interface a client can consume, where a .DSV/.dbl pair is a Windows-viewer file format. This is a deliberate PRODUCT divergence (docs/upgrade/DIVERGENCES.md), NOT an upstream defect: r4133 is doing what it means to do, so no investigations/to_opendss/ report is owed, and it costs exactly the two r4133-only names.
